start.title: Una voz en la noche
start.text:
El fuego de tu tienda ha menguado.
Isaac duerme junto a Sara —el hijo de la promesa, la risa de tu vejez.
Entonces, en el silencio, una voz que has conocido toda tu vida: «Abraham».

choices.text: [TODO:es] Answer at once: "Here I am"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The word leaves you before fear can catch it. "Here I am, Lord."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Pretend you did not hear
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You pull the blanket higher. The voice does not move on.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Demand to know what He wants first
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your heart bargains before it has even listened. The silence grows heavier.

doubt_consequence.title: Él no pasa de largo
doubt_consequence.text:
La voz no se va. Espera —paciente, inmensa, segura.
No puedes huir de Aquel que te llamó de Ur.
Te levantas de la cama y sales al aire frío.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bow low and answer at last: "Here I am"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You touch your forehead to the sand. "Here I am, Lord."

the_command.title: Toma a tu hijo
the_command.text:
[TODO:es] The words come, slow and terrible:
"Take your son, your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah.
Offer him there as a burnt offering, on a mountain I will show you."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Refuse — surely God could not ask this
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You shake your head. But the command does not unsay itself.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bow in trembling silence and accept
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You press your face to the ground. No words come — only surrender.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Beg God to take you instead
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] "Take me, Lord — not the boy." The heavens do not answer the trade.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:es] The God Who Gave Him
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] You stand alone under the vast stars.
This is the same God who promised Isaac when Sarah's womb was dead.
He gave the boy. He has not lied to you yet.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Trust the One who gave — and obey
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your refusal collapses. "He who gave can also keep."

bargain_consequence.title: [TODO:es] No Substitute You Can Offer
bargain_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Your bargains die in your throat.
This test is not for your life. It is for your heart.
The stars wait above you in their thousands — the very stars He once promised.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Let go of the bargain and obey
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You stop bargaining. There is nothing left but to trust.

the_weight.title: [TODO:es] Before the Dawn
the_weight.text:
[TODO:es] You sit by the dying fire until the sky greys.
Isaac breathes softly nearby. Sarah does not stir.
Soon the sun will rise — and you must move before your courage breaks.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Wake the servants and saddle the donkey at once
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Better to walk than to think. You rise and begin.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Wait — perhaps another sign will come
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Dawn comes anyway. The command does not change.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Wake Sarah and tell her everything
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your hand hovers over her shoulder — and falls back. She would not survive the parting.

delay_consequence.title: [TODO:es] No Other Sign Will Come
delay_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] The light grows. Birds begin their first calls.
The word once spoken does not need to be repeated.
Obedience delayed will not soften what must be done.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Rise and prepare for the journey
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You stand, stiff with the weight of it, and call the servants.

tell_sarah_consequence.title: [TODO:es] She Must Not Bear This
tell_sarah_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] She would tear the tent down.
She would cling to Isaac and curse the God who asked.
This burden is yours alone — and Isaac's, if it must be.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Leave quietly and prepare in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You step outside without a word. The dawn keeps your secret.

departure.title: [TODO:es] Three Days' Walk
departure.text:
[TODO:es] You split the wood for the burnt offering yourself — each blow of the axe heavier than the last.
You wake Isaac gently. Two servants come with you.
The land of Moriah lies three days to the north.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Set out at first light without explanation
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The boy follows, sleepy and trusting. You do not look back at the tent.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lie to Isaac about where you are going
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The lie tastes of ash. He believes you without question — which is worse.

lie_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Truth Enough for Today
lie_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] You cannot lie to him. Not the whole truth — but not a lie.
"We go to worship," you tell him. "God will provide."
It is more true than you yet understand.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk on with him into the dawn
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] He smiles up at you and takes your hand. The road begins.

the_road.title: [TODO:es] The Long Road North
the_road.text:
[TODO:es] Three days under a vast pale sky.
Isaac chatters about lambs and stars and what Sarah will cook when you return.
Every word is a small knife — and a small mercy.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Listen to him fully — store every word
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You drink in his voice as if it were the last well in the desert.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk apart and harden your heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You quicken your pace ahead of him. The distance does not protect you.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Turn back — claim the journey was a mistake
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your feet slow. But you cannot outrun the voice that called you.

harden_consequence.title: [TODO:es] A Father Cannot Harden Himself
harden_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] You cannot make yourself small enough to escape this.
If God provides nothing, you will lose him either way — once on the altar, and forever in your soul.
He deserves your love until the last step.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Slow down and walk beside him again
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You match his pace. He smiles up at you. You do not deserve that smile.

turn_back_consequence.title: [TODO:es] There Is No Going Back
turn_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] If you turn back now, every promise unravels.
The stars He counted, the nations He swore — all collapse on a refusal.
Faith is a road; you are already on it.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Face north again and keep walking
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You set your face like flint and walk on with him.

mountain_in_sight.title: [TODO:es] The Mountain Afar Off
mountain_in_sight.text:
[TODO:es] On the third day you lift your eyes — and see it.
A single peak in the distance, wrapped in pale haze.
Something inside you knows this is the place.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Tell the servants to wait here with the donkey
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] "Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go up to worship — and we will come again to you."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bring the servants up with you for support
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You take a step toward them — then stop. They cannot share this.

servants_consequence.title: [TODO:es] This Is for No Other Eyes
servants_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] If they witness, they will stop you. If they stop you, you have failed Him.
This is between you, the boy, and God.
No other hand may steady or hinder.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Tell them to wait here at the foot of the mountain
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] "Stay here. We will return to you." The words feel like prophecy you do not yet understand.

leave_servants.title: [TODO:es] He Will Carry the Wood
leave_servants.text:
[TODO:es] You lay the bundle of split wood across Isaac's strong young shoulders.
You carry the fire and the knife in your own hands.
Together you begin to climb the narrow path.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk in silence beside him
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Step by step, the path winds upward. The wind sings in the cliffs.

isaacs_question.title: [TODO:es] Where Is the Lamb?
isaacs_question.text:
[TODO:es] Halfway up, Isaac stops and turns to you.
"My father — behold the fire and the wood. But where is the lamb for the burnt offering?"
His eyes are clear and trusting. He waits for an answer.

choices.text: [TODO:es] "God Himself will provide a lamb, my son"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The words leave you like a prayer. Even you do not yet know what they mean.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Tell him the truth — that he is the lamb
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] His face goes white. He drops the wood and stumbles backward.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Say nothing and keep walking
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] He waits a long moment. Then quietly follows. Something in him knows.

tell_truth_consequence.title: [TODO:es] He Trusts You Still
tell_truth_consequence.text:
Él tiembla. Pero después de un largo silencio, vuelve a coger la leña.
No huye. No te maldice.
Camina a tu lado, porque confía en el Dios en el que tú siempre has confiado.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Walk with him in awed silence to the summit
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Two faiths walk side by side up the last of the path.

silence_consequence.title: La respuesta de la fe
silence_consequence.text:
No puedes dejar su pregunta sin respuesta, ni ahora ni nunca.
La fe no es silencio. La fe es la palabra pronunciada en la oscuridad.
Te vuelves hacia él.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Say: "God Himself will provide the lamb, my son"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You speak it. The mountain seems to hold its breath.

summit.title: El lugar que Él mostró
summit.text:
Llegas al lugar. El viento se calma.
Empiezas a recoger piedras. Isaac se arrodilla y te ayuda, sus pequeñas manos junto a las tuyas.
El altar se eleva: tosco, sagrado, terrible.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lay the wood in order upon the stones
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Each piece of wood goes down with care. The altar is ready.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stop — you cannot do this
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your hands fall to your sides. The wind picks up around you.

stop_consequence.title: Fe que cree en la resurrección
stop_consequence.text:
Tus manos tiemblan. Entonces un pensamiento te invade, más antiguo que el propio mandato:
«Aquel que dio a Isaac de un vientre estéril puede devolverlo de entre los muertos».
Lo crees. No lo entiendes. Pero lo crees.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Take up the wood and finish what was begun
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your hands steady. You complete the altar.

the_binding.title: Él no se resistió
the_binding.text:
Te vuelves hacia Isaac. No hay palabras, solo tus ojos encontrándose con los suyos.
Él ve. Él entiende. Y no huye.
Se arrodilla. Te deja atarle las manos. Se tumba sobre la leña.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Kiss his forehead and lift the knife
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] His tear meets your tear. You raise the knife.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Loose him — flee from the altar
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your hand finds the cord — but stops. To turn back now is to make all his courage worthless.

flee_consequence.title: Su fe te sostiene
flee_consequence.text:
El muchacho yace inmóvil debajo de ti, con los ojos cerrados, respirando con regularidad.
Confía. Se está ofreciendo contigo.
Si huyes, traicionas no solo a Dios, sino también la propia entrega de Isaac.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stand with him to the end — lift the knife
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You raise the knife above him, both hands trembling.

the_knife.title: ¡Abraham! ¡Abraham!
the_knife.text:
La hoja se eleva. Tus brazos son de piedra.
En el punto más alto, una voz rasga el cielo:
«¡Abraham! ¡Abraham!»

choices.text: [TODO:es] Answer at once: "Here I am"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The knife stops. "Here I am, Lord."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Strike before another command can come
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your arm tenses — then locks. You cannot. The voice has the right of way.

strike_consequence.title: La prueba no es sangre
strike_consequence.text:
Tu brazo no se moverá.
Dios no pidió la muerte, pidió el corazón que daría la muerte.
Le has dado ese corazón. La hoja ya ha hecho su trabajo.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lower the knife and answer the voice: "Here I am"
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The knife falls from your hand into the dust. "Here I am."

the_stay.title: No pongas tu mano sobre el muchacho
the_stay.text:
«No pongas tu mano sobre el muchacho. No le hagas nada.
Porque ahora sé que temes a Dios, pues no me has negado a tu hijo, tu único hijo».
Te arrodillas junto a él. El mundo vuelve a respirar.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Loose Isaac's hands and lift him from the wood
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your trembling fingers free him. He clings to you and weeps.

the_ram.title: Atrapado en la zarza
the_ram.text:
Levantas la vista, y allí, entre la maleza detrás del altar, un carnero está atrapado por los cuernos en la zarza.
No vino por el camino. Simplemente está allí.
Dios ha provisto.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Take the ram and offer it in Isaac's place
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You free the ram and lay it on the wood. The fire rises.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Refuse — sacrifice nothing now
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You stand frozen. The ram waits. The altar waits.

no_sacrifice_consequence.title: La adoración debe completarse
no_sacrifice_consequence.text:
Viniste a adorar. El altar todavía pide una ofrenda.
Dios ha provisto una; recibirla es el acto final de obediencia.
No ofrecerla es despreciar la misericordia.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Take the ram and complete the offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You free the ram and lay it on the wood. The smoke rises straight to heaven.

the_name.title: El Señor proveerá
the_name.text:
Nombres el lugar Yahveh-Yireh: «El Señor proveerá».
Isaac está a tu lado, vivo, respirando, su pequeña mano en la tuya.
El humo del carnero se eleva hacia el amplio cielo pálido.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Bow and listen — the voice is not finished
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You bow your head. The voice comes again, gentler this time.

the_blessing.title: Por mí mismo he jurado
the_blessing.text:
«Por mí mismo he jurado, dice el Señor:
por cuanto has hecho esto y no me has negado a tu hijo, tu único hijo,
de cierto te bendeciré, y multiplicaré tu descendencia como las estrellas del cielo y como la arena que está a la orilla del mar.
En tu descendencia serán benditas todas las naciones de la tierra, por cuanto has obedecido mi voz».

choices.text: [TODO:es] Take Isaac's hand and begin the long walk home
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You turn together toward the path, the sky burning gold around you.

homecoming.title: Hemos vuelto
homecoming.text:
Bajáis juntos la montaña mientras las estrellas empiezan a mostrarse.
Los siervos esperan donde los dejaste.
«Hemos vuelto a vosotros», dices, y es más cierto de lo que ellos jamás sabrán.
